wrapper.name: SCDraw_Tank
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Tank ----
EXTENDS Tank
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Tank_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Tank_Budget == SCDraw_Tank_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Tank_Broken == (IF NotOverflow THEN {} ELSE {"NotOverflow"})
SCDraw_Tank_Mark == IF SCDraw_Tank_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Tank_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<level>>, SCDraw_Tank_Broken>>)
====
